interpretation: Empirical vertical reflectivity profiles conditioned only on a low-level 2-D reflectivity proxy. This model is for validation and development, not yet a general operational storm-volume model.

low_level_proxy.definition: maximum measured DBZH at voxel altitudes <=1500 m AMSL
low_level_proxy.note: This is a historical pseudo-live proxy and is not claimed to reproduce the Bureau operational mosaic algorithm.
